name: tortoise-orm-portable-offline-migration-74bf
instr:
Allow Tortoise ORM users to carry an applied migration history between environments and inspect migrations accurately without connecting to the deployment database. A portable, versioned snapshot should give CLI planning, SQL rendering, and autodetection one shared historical frontier. When no snapshot is supplied, database-free CLI planning and history, sqlmigrate, and autodetection require no new configuration and retain their existing behavior.

`MigrationIdentity`, `MigrationHistorySnapshot`, `HistorySnapshotSource`, `normalized`, `SnapshotError`, `SnapshotFormatError`, `SnapshotValidationError`, `DuplicateMigrationIdentityError`, and `SnapshotDependencyError` are public from `tortoise.migrations.history_snapshot`; `MigrationHistorySnapshot.normalized(self)` and module-level `normalized(self)` deterministically order identities by application and name without concealing duplicates. `load_history_snapshot` and `dump_history_snapshot` from `tortoise.migrations.history_io` preserve version, identities, and optional source metadata, while malformed or unsupported data raises `SnapshotFormatError`. `ValidatedMigrationHistory` and `validate_history_snapshot` from `tortoise.migrations.history_validation` establish the single dependency-closed applied frontier used by every offline consumer, rejecting duplicates, unknown identities, and impossible dependency histories with the corresponding `SnapshotError` subtype before exposing partial results. `SnapshotMigrationRecorder` from
